title: Code structure and quality
intro: This section covers how the module is built rather than what it shows. Today one 3,304-line cubit owns every tab, navigation, a widget-owned TabController and analytics; states carry no equality, signals are sent as states, many imports are undeclared, 61 lints are switched off, and there is duplicated and dead code. The changes start with behaviour-preserving moves (helpers, deletions, typing, declared dependencies) and leave the high-risk per-tab split for later behind a flag, keeping the cubit's public members that other packages use.

measured.current: 3,304 lines, ~40 state classes in one state file
26 in lib/, 8 in test/ (2 would form cycles)
7 confirmed unreferenced files (~1,650 lines) + 7 cubit methods

changes.title: Split the cubit, starting with pure helpers
changes.summary: MoGetQuoteCubit is 3,304 lines with about 40 state classes and many mutable public fields. Start by moving pure formatting/mapping code into tested helper classes with no behaviour change; split per-tab cubits later behind a flag.
changes.risk_reason: The full split touches the cubit's core state flow and its public API, which other packages use (trader_native_charts calls updateSelectedScripId and sets indexQuoteDetail; trader_orders market_depth_sheet uses isDepthExpanded; mo_portfolio_2_0 calls getIt<MoGetQuoteCubit>().setAlert and reads quoteScripDetails; super_app trader_bloc.dart:69 provides an app-level instance). Step 1 alone is Low risk.

files.change: Step 1: move formatExpiry, _formatStrikePrice, financial chart mapping (_createFinancialChartData, _getDataForTab, _formatYear, _formatCurrency, _comparePeriods, _getMonthNumber), _processBuildupData and the merge switches into helper classes.

changes.current: One cubit holds header/dashboard, futures, options, index, Overview, Fundamentals, Technicals, News/Events, Transactions, financial chart state, navigation and analytics. Every emit goes to every BlocBuilder on the page, so each widget needs a long buildWhen list, and the class cannot be tested in parts. About 700 lines are pure functions that do not need cubit state.
steps: Step 1 (Low risk, S-M): move pure helpers to new files; keep thin private wrappers in the cubit that delegate, so call sites and tests do not change. Add unit tests for the helpers (K4).
Step 2 (Medium): introduce a QuoteHeaderController/hub owning scripId, dashboard, broadcast symbol and live tick (single subscription), exposed as a ValueListenable or small cubit.

Step 3 (High, behind Remote Config 'quote_split_cubits', default off): per-tab cubits in this order, each provided under the content area: QuoteTechnicalsCubit (~170 lines), QuoteNewsEventsCubit (~200), QuoteTransactionsCubit (~150), QuoteFundamentalsCubit (~550), QuoteOverviewCubit (~450), QuoteDerivativesCubit (~600).
Keep MoGetQuoteCubit as a facade with the members used outside the module (setAlert, updateSelectedScripId, indexQuoteDetail, isDepthExpanded, quoteScripDetails) until those callers are migrated.
safety: Step 1 moves code verbatim behind the same private methods: output is identical and existing 134 cubit tests keep passing.
Steps 2-3 ship behind a Remote Config flag; the facade keeps the external API unchanged.
regression_checks: Step 1: full cubit test suite; Financials chart for all tabs; options strike labels; futures expiry labels.
Step 3: full quote regression on cash, futures, options, index; charts screen, market depth sheet in Orders, portfolio Set Alert.
changes.after_improvement: Cubit file under ~2,600 lines after step 1 and under ~800 per class after step 3; helpers covered by fast unit tests.

changes.title: Move navigation and BuildContext out of the cubit
changes.summary: The cubit navigates (Navigator.pushNamed, Routes.navigateToReplacement, CommonRoute.navigateToWebView, MaterialPageRoute), takes BuildContext parameters and stores a TabController. Move these to a UI-side navigator and keep only data preparation in the cubit.
changes.risk_reason: Same routes and arguments are used, but call sites in widgets and in mo_portfolio_2_0 (setAlert) change; back-stack behaviour must be re-checked.

files.change: Replace navigateToCharts/navigateToOptionChain/navigateToResearchReport/setAlert(context, ...) with methods that return ChartsArguments / OptionChainArgument / alert URL.
Call the navigator with args from the cubit.

changes.current: navigateToCharts (1762-1807) and navigateToOptionChain (1810-1848) build arguments and push routes with a BuildContext passed into the cubit; setAlert (3141-3172) awaits an API call and then uses the context to open a web view; setTabController (3136-3138) keeps a widget-owned TabController. This ties the cubit to the widget tree, makes the methods untestable without a navigator, and caused I1.
steps: Add buildChartsArguments(), buildOptionChainArguments() and Future<PriceAlertResponse?> fetchAlertTarget(scripCode, exchange) to the cubit (pure/data).
Create QuoteNavigation in helper/ with the existing Navigator/Routes/CommonRoute calls copied verbatim.
Update the four widget call sites.
Keep setAlert(context, ...) as a deprecated wrapper that calls the new pair, because mo_portfolio_2_0 calls it in three files.
Remove tabController from the cubit; the swipe handler asks the cubit for the next section and calls changeSection.
safety: Route names, arguments and replace/push choice are copied unchanged.
Deprecated wrapper keeps the external setAlert callers in mo_portfolio_2_0 working.
regression_checks: Chart button (app bar scrolled and info card), with replace=false.
Option chain from index and stock.
Set Alert from quote and from portfolio stock/bond/dividend sheets.
Reports button.
changes.after_improvement: Navigation methods become testable without a widget tree; the cubit no longer holds widget objects.

changes.title: Inject connectivity, clock and analytics
changes.summary: The cubit calls the global checkInternetConnectivity(), DateTime.now() is read directly, and analytics go through singletons (MoEngageQuotePageHelper.instance, QuoteRevampCleverTapHelper.instance). Pass them in through the constructor with defaults so tests can control them.
changes.risk_reason: Constructor gets optional parameters whose defaults are today's globals, so DI registration and runtime behaviour do not change.

files.change: Add optional ConnectivityChecker, Clock and QuoteAnalytics parameters; use them instead of globals.
Route events through cubit.analytics instead of MoEngageQuotePageHelper.instance.
Regenerated by build_runner; factory still passes only the repository.

changes.current: changeSection awaits the global checkInternetConnectivity() (trader_core connectivity_manager.dart:190), which the test suite cannot fake (test comment at mo_get_quote_cubit_test.dart:3445-3449 says so; the suite only mocks the connectivity channel to return 'wifi'). Analytics events are fired from an extension on the cubit through static helpers, and time-based logic uses DateTime.now().
steps: Define typedef ConnectivityChecker = Future<bool> Function({bool force}); and a small QuoteAnalytics interface with the methods the extension already calls.
MoGetQuoteCubit(this._repository, {ConnectivityChecker? connectivity, DateTime Function()? now, QuoteAnalytics? analytics}) with defaults to the current globals.
Mark the extra parameters @ignoreParam (injectable) or keep them optional so the generated factory is unchanged.
Use the injected checker in changeSection and in the reconnect listener (H6).
safety: Defaults are the same functions used today.
Generated DI factory keeps calling MoGetQuoteCubit(repository).
regression_checks: Tab switch online/offline shows the same no-internet section error.
MoEngage/CleverTap events still fire (check debug event log for screen_viewed and tab_switched).
changes.after_improvement: Offline, time and analytics paths become unit-testable (K3).

changes.title: Give states value equality with a version
changes.summary: No state class overrides == (none use Equatable), so every emit rebuilds every matching builder even when nothing changed, e.g. three identical MoGetQuoteFundamentalLoaded in a row. Add Equatable with a cheap version prop; do not deep-compare protobuf payloads.
changes.risk_reason: Bloc skips an emit equal to the current state; event-like states that are re-emitted on purpose (SectionChanged, AccordionExpanded) must keep firing, so they need a sequence number in props.

files.change: abstract class MoGetQuoteState extends Equatable; data states props = [data.version]; event-like states props include a seq.
Add int version, incremented in copyWith only when a field reference changes (identical check).

changes.current: State classes are plain classes (mo_get_quote_state.dart:5-290). The loadEssentialFundamentalData test expects three MoGetQuoteFundamentalLoaded in a row (test:1060-1064) because the foreground pass and each background section emit even when data is unchanged; each emit rebuilds the Fundamentals widgets and StickyChipsSection.
steps: Add equatable to pubspec (J6) and make MoGetQuoteState extend Equatable with props => const [] for empty states.
Data managers: version field; copyWith computes changed = !identical(a, this.a) || ...; returns this when nothing changed.
MoGetQuoteOverviewLoaded/FundamentalLoaded/TechnicalLoaded: props => [data.version].

SectionChanged, SectionChangeLoading, AccordionExpanded, ButtonVisibilityChanged, ScripIdChanged: add a static int _seq counter to props so repeated emits still go out (until J5 turns them into events).
Run all tests; update K2 expectations (one FundamentalLoaded instead of three when data is unchanged).
safety: Event-like states keep firing because seq differs on every emit.
Only truly unchanged data states are dropped, which does not change what is shown.
regression_checks: Full quote regression; especially chip scroll, accordion expand from chips, exchange toggle, and tab re-selection.
Count rebuilds of FundamentalsScreen with DevTools 'Track widget rebuilds' before/after.
changes.after_improvement: Fewer redundant rebuilds (e.g. 3 -> 1 Fundamentals rebuild for unchanged data); buildWhen can use prev != curr.

changes.title: Turn event-like states into a side-effect stream
changes.summary: AccordionExpanded, ButtonVisibilityChanged, ScripIdChanged, NewsTabChanged and SectionChanged(shouldScroll) are one-off signals emitted as states. Each one replaces the last data state, so builders without a tight buildWhen fall back to defaults. Send them on a separate stream.
changes.risk_reason: Changes how listeners receive scroll/streaming/visibility signals; each consumer must be moved in the same change.

files.change: Add a broadcast StreamController<QuoteUiEvent> and emit events there.
Listen to ScripChanged event for streaming.
Add buildWhen limited to corporate-action states.

changes.current: notifyAccordionExpanded (3191-3202) emits a state that StickyChipsSection reacts to; updateButtonVisibility (1424-1432) is called on every scroll threshold crossing and emits a state; updateSelectedScripId emits ScripIdChanged after a network call. Because the cubit has a single current state, after one of these emits the current state is no longer the data state: EventsContentWidget (BlocBuilder without buildWhen, 47-48) and StockInfoCard._buildPriceInfo (no buildWhen, 254-270) rebuild on every one of them.
steps: sealed class QuoteUiEvent { AccordionExpand, ButtonVisibility, ScripChanged, NewsTabChanged, ScrollToSection }.
final StreamController<QuoteUiEvent> _events = StreamController.broadcast(); Stream<QuoteUiEvent> get uiEvents => _events.stream; close it in close().
Emit both the old state and the new event for one release (flag), move consumers to uiEvents, then stop emitting the old states.
Button visibility becomes a ValueNotifier<ButtonVisibility> read by the two button rows.
safety: Transition release emits both forms so no consumer misses a signal.
Data states stay the current state, so builders see consistent data.
regression_checks: Accordion expand from chips and from Overview cards scrolls correctly.
Live price after exchange toggle and expiry change.
Chart/option-chain buttons appear after scroll.
changes.after_improvement: Data states are no longer replaced by signals; fewer rebuilds of widgets without buildWhen.

changes.title: Declare every imported package in pubspec
changes.summary: pubspec.yaml declares 9 non-SDK dependencies, but lib/ imports 26 more packages and test/ imports 8 undeclared dev packages. It resolves only because of the workspace. Declare them, and break the two dependency cycles.
changes.risk_reason: Build metadata only; same versions as the workspace. The two cycles need a design choice and are listed as a separate step.

files.change: Add the missing dependencies and dev_dependencies with the workspace constraints.

changes.current: Imported in lib/ but not declared: mofsl_ui_library, mosl_broadcaster, trader_widget_ui, trader_trading_core, trader_orders, trader_webpage, shimmer, trader_common_repository, rise_deeplink, rect_getter, mosl_security, intl, trader_watchlist, base_network, flutter_initicon, carousel_slider, trader_research_product, trader_report_news, trader_bottom_bar, syncfusion_flutter_gauges, mosl_socket_core, mo_basket_bulk_order, meta, get, dropdown_button2, cached_network_image. Imported in test/ but not declared: mocktail, bloc_test, hive, shared_preferences, mosl_socket_security, mosl_security, mosl_broadcaster, base_network. trader_orders and trader_watchlist already depend on mo_get_quote (their pubspecs list it), so declaring them creates cycles. depend_on_referenced_packages is ignored in analysis_options.yaml, so none of this is reported.
steps: Add the 24 non-cyclic packages under dependencies with the same source/constraint the workspace uses (path for local packages, git/hosted as in super_app's pubspec).
Add mocktail, bloc_test, hive, shared_preferences, mosl_socket_security, mosl_security, mosl_broadcaster, base_network to dev_dependencies (those already in dependencies stay there).

Cycles: replace the trader_orders imports (place_order_navigator, cas_info_sheet, place_order_validator, advanced_option_model, bulk_basket_order_arguments) and trader_watchlist's watchlist_utils with RiseAppModule hooks or move them to trader_core; until then document the cycle and verify 'melos list --cycles' and 'dart pub get' succeed.
Re-enable depend_on_referenced_packages (J7) once done.

changes.title: Re-enable a safe lint subset and remove prints
changes.summary: analysis_options.yaml sets 61 diagnostics to ignore, including several that hide real bugs. Turn a first safe group back on as warnings and remove the print/debugPrint calls they flag.
changes.risk_reason: Analyzer settings and log calls only; no runtime behaviour change except fewer log lines.

files.change: Remove ignores for the first group (listed in steps).
Remove the two print() calls that log the recent-search list.

changes.current: Ignored today include avoid_print, depend_on_referenced_packages, unused_element, unused_field, unused_local_variable, dead_code, dead_null_aware_expression (would have flagged the '?? 0' bug in I5), empty_catches, unnecessary_null_comparison, invalid_use_of_protected_member, prefer_const_constructors, and even return_of_invalid_type, return_without_value, use_of_void_result and not_assigned_potentially_non_nullable_local_variable. The lib has 2 print calls (cubit 2962 and 2975 print every recent-search item on each Overview load), 45 debugPrint calls (several inside build methods), 4 dev.log calls and 6 commented-out prints.
steps: Group 1 (now): dead_null_aware_expression, unnecessary_null_comparison, unused_element, unused_field, unused_local_variable, dead_code, avoid_print, empty_catches -> warning. Fix the findings (most are deletions, J11).

Group 3: prefer_const_constructors, prefer_const_constructors_in_immutables -> info, fix with dart fix --apply.

changes.summary: Semantics, semanticLabel, tooltip and TextScaler are used 0 times in lib/. Icon-only buttons (back, alert, watchlist, chart, option chain, More) have no labels, and several fixed heights clip at large text sizes.

changes.product_decision: Please provide approved screen-reader labels (English and Hindi if localised) for: Back, Set alert, Add to watchlist, Open chart, Open option chain, More options, NSE/BSE toggle, each section tab. Should layouts grow at text scale above 1.3, or cap scaling at 1.3 for the header?

files.change: Wrap icon buttons in Semantics(button: true, label: ...).
Replace fixed height spacing30*2 with a minHeight constraint.

changes.current: The back button is an InkWell around an MOIcon (app bar 112-126) with no label, so TalkBack/VoiceOver reads nothing useful. The sticky chips row is a fixed 60 px Container (sticky_chips_section.dart:177) and the app bar has a fixed preferred size (36), so at large font sizes text is clipped.
steps: Add Semantics(button: true, label: MoGetQuoteStrings.backA11y, child: ...) to each icon-only button, using strings from Product.
Replace fixed heights with ConstrainedBox(minHeight: ...) where the content is text.
Scale app bar preferredSize with MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(56).
Add a widget test that pumps the header at textScaler 2.0 and expects no overflow (K6).
safety: At default text scale, sizes are the same (min constraints equal the old fixed sizes).
regression_checks: TalkBack and VoiceOver walk-through of the header and tabs.
System font size largest: header, chips, bottom bar not clipped.
changes.after_improvement: All icon-only controls on the quote page announced by screen readers; no clipping at 1.3x and 2.0x text scale.

changes.title: Move flash-news banner logic into the cubit
changes.summary: The screen widget decides whether to show the flash-news banner, reads and writes Preferences, and calls setState on the whole screen from a BlocConsumer listener. Move the decision and persistence into the cubit and expose a ValueListenable for the banner.
changes.risk_reason: Changes when the banner decision is computed (cubit vs post-frame/listener); the 24-hour and 'already seen' rules must stay identical.

files.change: After parsing flash news, compute visibility with the same rules and set flashNewsBanner; add dismissFlashNews().

changes.current: _checkNewsTimestamp (78-100) runs in a post-frame callback and on every MoGetQuoteOverviewLoaded (239-241), reads Preferences.getFlashNewsId, applies a 24-hour window, and calls setState on the whole screen, which rebuilds the Scaffold and the CustomScrollView. The listener at 210-229 writes Preferences and calls setState again when the asset type is not cash. DateTime.now() is read directly, so the rule cannot be unit-tested.
steps: Add final ValueNotifier<flash.FlashNews?> flashNewsBanner to the cubit.
In _parseFlashNewsResponse compute isVisible with the same rules (asset type cash, within 24 h using the injected clock from J3, id != stored id) and set the notifier.
dismissFlashNews() writes Preferences.setFlashNewsId/Time exactly as onClose does today and sets the notifier to null; call it also from changeAssetType when leaving cash (same as 214-228).
In the screen, replace the setState branch with ValueListenableBuilder around the Positioned banner only.
Unit-test the rule with a fake clock (K4).
safety: Same visibility rule, same Preferences keys and values.
Only the banner subtree rebuilds instead of the whole screen.
regression_checks: Stock with flash news < 24 h old: banner shows; close it; re-open quote: not shown.
Switch Cash -> Futures with banner visible: banner hides and is marked seen (as today).
News older than 24 h: not shown.
changes.after_improvement: No full-screen setState for the banner; rule covered by unit tests.
